title: Shaft critical speed
line: Dunkerley, a beam model and Rayleigh for a stepped shaft with two discs.
description: First critical speed of a stepped steel shaft on two bearings 1.2 m apart, with a 25 kg and a 40 kg disc: Dunkerley's lower bound, a beam model, Rayleigh's upper bound.
thumbnailAlt: Bar chart of the shaft's first critical speed by three methods, rendered by RunMat
